description: Fake bank KYC call asks to install AnyDesk. Remote access + banking app = hard override tier 3.

events.text: Sir main SBI bank se bol raha hoon. Aapka KYC update nahi hua, aapka account blocked ho jayega abhi.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Aapko ek app download karna hai, AnyDesk. Install the app and tell me the code. Apna OTP bhi batao.
events.speaker: caller
